# Techy Pwint

> Techy Pwint is Pwint San's service business. It builds websites, AI workflows, custom Claude skills and video ads for business owners and creators in Thailand, Myanmar and Southeast Asia. Every service is done for you or taught to you. Work is available in English, Burmese and Thai.

Pwint San is an entrepreneur and AI & digital marketing strategist based in Thailand, with an MBA in Marketing Management and a UI/UX Design Certification from Springboard. Pwint San has designed 30+ WordPress websites, built chatbot and marketing solutions for 90+ SMEs, and is a former CEO.

## Packages (prices in USD)

- [Niche Finding & Content Strategy](https://pwintsan4238.github.io/#free): Free. Pick a niche, define your audience, set 3 content pillars and get 10 starter content ideas.
- [Web Package: Website + AEO/SEO + Video Ads](https://pwintsan4238.github.io/#packages): $600–1,000. A custom mobile-friendly website of up to 5 pages, SEO and answer engine optimization for AI assistants, plus 2–3 short video ads. Takes 2–4 weeks.
- [AI Skill Package: Custom Claude Skill Development](https://pwintsan4238.github.io/#packages): $150–400. One custom Claude skill with your brand voice, rules, examples and templates, for tasks such as content writing, customer replies, reports and proposals. Takes about 3–7 days.
- [AI Workflow for Business](https://pwintsan4238.github.io/#packages): $400–800. An AI system for content creation, scheduling, brand consistency and customer replies, with 2 weeks of support. Takes 1–2 weeks.
- [AI Workflow for Creators](https://pwintsan4238.github.io/#packages): $200–400. A personal brand voice profile, an AI workflow for ideas, scripts, captions and hooks, and a repurposing system. Takes 1–2 weeks.
- [AI Video Creation Course](https://pwintsan4238.github.io/#packages): $100–150. Learn to make short-form videos with AI tools for TikTok, Reels and Shorts.

Bundles get a discount. Payment is 50% upfront and 50% on delivery. Courses are paid in full at enrollment.
